title: Split direction is a two-faced slow signal: long forward-split states, short reverse-split states, within-sector, market-neutral, on the death-inclusive cohort - built ENTIRELY from the newly-eligible EODHD owner-entitled splits field family on the frozen quarterly decision grid

mechanism.underreacting_party: attention-constrained, nominal-price-anchored holders of thin-coverage micro-caps: before a split the name is low-priced, low-visibility and broker-neglected; the split's signal content (and the publicity it brings per Brennan-Hughes 1991) reaches the attention-constrained marginal holder slowly, so the repricing takes quarters (Hirshleifer-Teoh 2003; Duffie 2010)
mechanism.forced_trader_claim: NONE CLAIMED - honest scope note: no party is forced to trade a split state; the mechanism is entirely on the underreaction side, which sets the cost bar exactly as declared in SFV13-A6-P1. Expected crowding at quarterly-decision/daily-fill clocks after band costs is declared LOW on an information set this program has never staged
mechanism.why: splits are management statements, not mechanical events: forward splits signal private optimism and keep the price in an attractive trading range (Grinblatt-Masulis-Titman 1984; Ikenberry-Rankine-Stice 1996 document ~8% post-split drift on 2-for-1 splits attributable to signaling and range maintenance); reverse splits signal distress and listing-floor defense, with documented NEGATIVE post-event drift (Desai-Jain 1997 document both faces in one design). The two faces are what a death-inclusive cohort is built to test: forward-split drift is the attention channel working for neglected names, reverse-split drift is the death-process edge bleeding slowly - both declared, both falsifiable, and the permutation control decides whether either face is information or composition
mechanism.observable: the PIT split-DIRECTION STATE per entity per decision date, assembled ONLY from vendor-recorded split factors and their dates: let r be the most recent staged split ratio (new shares per old share) with split date in [D - 180 calendar days, D); X = +1 if r > 1 (forward), X = -1 if r < 1 (reverse), X = 0 otherwise. A ratio of exactly 1 or an unparsable record FAILS CLOSED to the defect table (never guessed). No price, return, volume, share COUNT, filing field or revision observable enters the exposure - the split factor is a mechanical corporate-action fact and the only observable read
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) if split-state drift is a momentum residue - splits follow price run-ups (Lakonishok-Lev 1987), so the D2 novelty gate vs the momentum veto entry is THE declared binding measurement; an over-bar rho kills the family pre-selection and that is an accepted outcome; (ii) if the reverse-split short leg's expectancy is pure death-tail composition - then the permutation control reproduces the anchor and the family dies per the frozen rule; (iii) if split incidence is too thin to fund the leg floors over the 27 scored grid dates - INFEASIBLE at P2, the declared coverage kill point, never silently thinned
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: the convenient explanation is 'splitters are just recent winners and reverse-splitters just losers - the state adds nothing beyond what momentum already knows'. Two designed discriminators, both frozen: (a) the within-decision, within-sector PERMUTATION sham (V5/V6 standard, matched windows on permuted conditioning) destroys the name-to-state link while preserving the exact state multiset, eligibility, sector structure, weights, fills, costs and dead-leg semantics - if it reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x, or outrunning a negative anchor), the priced object was composition; (b) the D2 pooled-|rho| <= 0.20 gate vs ALL FOURTEEN veto entries on the declared conditioning exposure measures the momentum-residue reading directly - a failure there is a pre-selection death, recorded as a successful falsification, not a near-miss

lineage_citations: Fama, Fisher, Jensen & Roll (1969), 'The Adjustment of Stock Prices to New Information', International Economic Review 10(1) - the founding event study: splits are absorbed with dividend accompaniment as information, not mechanical price events

Lakonishok & Lev (1987), 'Stock Splits and Stock Dividends: Why, Who, and When', Journal of Financial Economics 7 - splits follow price appreciation (the range-management motive); the SOURCE of the momentum-adjacency risk this proposal declares as its binding D2 measurement

Grinblatt, Masulis & Titman (1984), 'The Valuation Effects of Stock Splits and Stock Dividends', Journal of Financial Economics 3 - announcement-window evidence that splits convey management's private information, strongest where the firm is least followed

Ikenberry, Rankine & Stice (1996), 'What Do Stock Splits Really Signal?', Financial Analysts Journal 52(4) - post-split drift of ~7-8% over the following year on 2-for-1 splits, concentrated in low-visibility names - the drift this grid samples at quarterly cadence

Desai & Jain (1997), 'Long-Run Common Stock Returns Following Stock Splits and Reverse Splits', Journal of Business 70(3) - the two-faced result this anchor is built on: forward splits drift positive, REVERSE splits drift NEGATIVE, in one unified design

Brennan & Hughes (1991), 'Stock Prices and the Supply of Information', Journal of Finance 46 - the publicity/attention channel: brokerage attention scales with price levels, so the pre-split low-price name sits in the attention shadow exactly where the signal accrues
Hirshleifer & Teoh (2003), 'Limited Attention, Information Disclosure, and Financial Reporting', Journal of Accounting and Economics 36 - the under-impounding channel
Duffie (2010), 'Asset Price Dynamics with Slow-Moving Capital', Journal of Finance 65(4) - the persistence floor for a 21-session hold sampled at quarterly decision cadence

entry_exit_fills: band-resolved house fills on the frozen grid: state and eligibility computed from split_date < D and bars through D-1; orders filled at the FIRST SESSION STRICTLY AFTER D (STRICT_NEXT_BAR, no same-day fill), close-to-close; fill-check: a name without a bar at the fill session simply does not fill (its order does not exist; legs are NOT renormalized - realized gross is reported); holding one 21-session span measured in the filled entity's own trading sessions; per-entity thinning 'at most one NEW position per 21-session span' is structurally satisfied by the quarterly grid (63 >> 21) and is declared as a constant, not a filter; force-flat with cost at every fold boundary (folds: S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09, S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24, carried verbatim from p3); costs verbatim from p3: 'band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side base, stress x2 applied to booked PnL; costs linear in fills; charged exactly once per fill'; L-I3 fail-closed band resolution throughout (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py: BandResolutionError, silent 10 bps fallback forbidden); dead-name exits per dead_leg_handling, charged via resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling 25 bps base / 50 stress when the exit band is unrateable)

anchor_arm.spec: sector-residual daily long/short under the V11 sec2.1 provision (p3 verbatim: 'sector-residual books for mechanism-justified NEW families, frozen gates unchanged'), implemented as WITHIN-SECTOR DEMEANED weights - no ETF legs exist in any arm. Frozen justification, stated HERE before selection: split DIRECTION incidence is sector-sticky - reverse splits concentrate in biotech/pharma and other listing-floor-defending micro-cap sectors - so without demeaning the short leg IS a sector short, which is the program's most repeated measured killer; the provision exists for exactly this mechanism-justified new-family case. Implementation: within each mapped cohort sector tag s, demean X_i (the +-1/0 split-direction state); leg weights proportional to the demeaned exposure scaled by 1.4826 * MAD (the frozen min_hist_frozen scale convention); long positive (forward-split states), short negative (reverse-split states), normalized to gross 1.0 (0.5 per leg); abstain if either leg < 5 names or the cohort scoreable floor (< 30 mapped-sector valid exposures at D) is unmet. The zero-state mass carries near-zero weights by construction and contributes the control mass of the cross-section

neighbour_arm.spec: identical machinery, eligibility, clock, book form, floors and fills, with the exposure recomputed as the signed SIGNAL MAGNITUDE X' = ln(r) over the same qualifying record (continuous; ln(2:1) = +0.693, ln(1:10) = -2.303; unparsable/unity fails closed as the anchor). Materially different construction, declared mechanism content: signal-strength faces of the same act - if magnitude carries the effect, the mechanism reads signal intensity (a bigger forward split or a more desperate reverse split is a stronger statement); if only the discrete direction state carries it, the priced object is the policy ACT itself, and a magnitude-only result downweights the act reading. The neighbour changes exactly one thing (the exposure algebra: direction indicator -> signed log-ratio) and nothing else

control_arms.spec: deterministic within-decision, WITHIN-SECTOR permutation sham (matched windows on permuted conditioning; the V5/V6 sham standard carried in p3 lane mandates, and the V12-A6 precedent control form): at each scored decision date, the anchor's exposure VALUES are permuted across that date's eligible names INSIDE each mapped sector tag using a frozen deterministic hash order (sha256 of the string cycle|{hypothesis_id}|{cik}|{decision_index}, hex-sorted - no RNG library, byte-reproducible). The permutation preserves the exact within-date and within-sector multiset of states (+1/-1/0 counts per sector), the exact eligibility set, the exact demeaning and MAD-scale machinery, and all fill/cost/dead-leg machinery, while destroying the name-to-state link. RUNNABILITY by construction: it abstains exactly where the anchor abstains and can never abort on data semantics (forex V3 lesson); every input is a staged split record, a staged price bar and a pinned cohort tag. Refutation semantics: if the sham reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x expectancy, or outrunning a negative anchor), the priced object was size, sector composition or death-tail structure rather than split-signal information, and the family dies per the frozen falsification-by-control rule. This control knowingly walks into the reverse-leg composition question; that is its purpose

falsification_rule: FROZEN, no gate weakened to admit a thin margin (P-2 margins recorded per gate per arm, never traded away): (1) CONTROL REPRODUCTION -> DEAD: control expectancy same-sign >= 0.5x the anchor's, including the negative-anchor case (the control never outruns a negative anchor); (2) SELF-SUBSUMPTION -> DESIGN FAILURE killed PRE-SCORE: pooled Spearman rho between anchor and control exposure vectors > 0.98 (the sham was not executed as declared); (3) anchor expectancy <= 0 after base band costs -> REJECT; (4) NOVELTY -> DEAD PRE-SELECTION: pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the declared conditioning exposure X and ANY of the FOURTEEN veto entries, measured at D2 on the same (entity, decision-date) cohort, fail-closed - for THIS family the momentum entry (entry 1) is the DECLARED BINDING measurement, accepted as a kill; (5) STRESS: stress x2 PnL <= 0 or stress PF < 1.0 -> dead; (6) DROP-ONE failure (symbol or fold) -> dead; (7) REPRODUCTION: twin rerun not ALL_MATCH -> dead; (8) FLOORS: any floor abstained under count -> INFEASIBLE (declared terminal, never a silently reduced book); (9) P2 COVERAGE: splits-family fold-window coverage cannot fund the floors over the 27 scored grid dates -> INFEASIBLE at P2 (the declared kill point, before any scored cell). REJECT is a successful research outcome

expected_failure_mode.most_likely_measured_kill: D2 momentum adjacency: splits follow price run-ups (Lakonishok-Lev 1987 - the literature itself names the confound), so the split-state vector may carry pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs the momentum veto entry on the conditioning-exposure measurement; this is DECLARED the binding pre-selection risk and an over-bar reading is an accepted death, recorded as successful falsification - the family does not argue with D2
expected_failure_mode.second_risk: the reverse-split short leg is death-process composition: reverse splits precede delistings in this cohort, so a naive short-reverse book may be harvesting the dying tail rather than Desai-Jain drift; the within-sector permutation sham discriminates exactly this, and a sham reproduction is pre-committed as fatal
expected_failure_mode.third_risk: incidence thinness: split events are rarer than dividend records; individual scored dates may abstain under the leg floor (>= 5 per leg) -> counted, INFEASIBLE if under the overall/per-fold floors
expected_failure_mode.fourth_risk: fold-MDD spikes from the reverse leg in stressed regimes (2020/2022 folds) even if expectancy is positive
